continuous_interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of trial means; seed 6216
paired_difference_interval: Conservative Bonferroni-adjusted marginal exact binomial bounds; paired exact McNemar with Holm correction within method/disturbance families
failure_selection: First failed seed, none before disturbance: first reference-method task failure and first comparator failure for each comparator in config order. Preserve matched iterative trial regardless of outcome. Hero: lowest successful complete/iterative/none seed, if any.
supersession: Separate calibrated-camera replication; does not supersede or pool historical 48 ideal-wrist trials. All 48 trials rerun using image-estimated wrist calibration.
interpretation: Paired replication on previously used seeds 400-407, not an unseen holdout. Seed400 was used for calibration integration checks. All controller, thresholds and sensor delays unchanged. Compare feedback modes under the same estimated calibration; do not claim architectural superiority in advance. Simulator object/camera truth used downstream for evaluation only. Eight trials per configuration; report uncertainty and all failures.
wrist_calibration: demo_data/calibration/wrist/estimated; image-estimated K and AX=XB hand-eye
